text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — prepping the EBR follow-up for NovaPay. We surfaced a few onboarding gaps that could become renewal risks if not closed before the exec readout next Tues. Need a short slide + clear action list for the execs. TL;DR: delayed product rollout, SSO misconfig, 2 enablement sessions still pending, feedback loop not closed from integrations team.
Dylan Kim: I can own the "current health + risk" slide. Can someone drop the latest timeline and the gap list? :+1:
Ashley Rivera: Adding timeline now. FYI support ticket backlog is blocking SSO progress — ETA from infra team is EOW.
Ryan O'Neal: Renewal risk: if SSO slips past the quarter boundary we lose contract leverage. Propose contingency: temporary SAML workaround + higher touch CS enablement. Emma, can you scope effort?
Emma Zhou: Yep — scoped. Temporary SAML shim is ~3 dev-days + config. Enablement: 2 1hr sessions (ops + product) and one recorded playbook. Draft action table below and slide link: `https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1aBcDEfGHijklMnoPqR`
```
Action items (owner — due)
1) SSO blocker triage (Ashley/Infra) — 2024-08-02
2) Build + deploy SAML shim (Eng - Dylan/Dev lead) — 2024-08-05
3) Schedule enablement sessions (Emma) — 2024-08-03
4) Integration feedback triage (CS Ops - Maya) — 2024-07-31
5) Exec slide + one pager (Dylan + Maya) — 2024-07-29 EOD
```
Maya Patel: Nice. For the exec one-pager let's call out measurable mitigation and ask: (A) temporary workaround in place, (B) commit to training + playbook, (C) propose renewal cadence extension if rollout slips.
Dylan Kim: I'll add those asks to the slide notes. Can someone do a quick risk severity label (High/Med/Low) next to each action?
Ashley Rivera: Marking SSO blocker = High, Build shim = Med, Enablement = Med, Feedback triage = Low
Ryan O'Neal: Agree. Also recommend we request a short exec sign-off on the contingency plan during the EBR so nothing is ambiguous.
Emma Zhou: I'll book the sessions and record them. Emma -> will own the playbook draft, posting link to draft in #playbooks when ready.
cxs-bot: Reminder set: EBR prep sync — 2024-07-29 09:00.
Maya Patel: Can everyone confirm slide ownership and that they can deliver by EOD Mon (2024-07-29)? If yes, react :white_check_mark:, if no, say what blocks you.
Dylan Kim: :white_check_mark:
Ashley Rivera: :white_check_mark: infra ETA might slip, but we'll escalate if needed.
Ryan O'Neal: :white_check_mark: will prepare the talking points for exec ask.
Emma Zhou: :white_check_mark: will have enablement calendar + playbook outline.
